name: Ordinary Days
source:
A school-life visual novel combining romance, comedy and psychological horror. The opening chapter follows Monday through Friday as a nameable protagonist gets to know classmates, friends and members of the student council, literature club and volleyball team. Dialogue choices shape replies and character reactions while unsettling moments interrupt the everyday routine.

The available Chapter 1 playtest is in English. It includes AI-assisted writing and code, generated visuals and some generated music. Licensed music and recorded sound effects are credited separately.
